subject: CI and SE for ZIP model using pcount

messages.author: 2a3a0c6a456f3043
messages.subject: CI and SE for ZIP model using pcount
parts:
When I use the function:
Mode.zip <- bup(ranef(M5.zip), stat="mode")

I get confidence intervals but the following message
Warning message:
In .local(object, ...) :
  Method to compute SE for ZIP model has not been written

I also get SE for the coefficients of the ZIP model. I'm just curious if this is a problem with the CI for N[i] or the SE for other parameter estimates?

messages.author: df74d6fccec2ff7e
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] CI and SE for ZIP model using pcount
parts:
Hi Dan,

ranef() calls predict(), and the predict() method for ZIP models generates this warning message. You can ignore it if you are using ranef(). The reason predict() doesn't compute the SEs and CIs is that I haven't written the code for the delta method for this case.

Richard
